source_evidence: Player exact 'Lets check with the sergeant and the status of Quenwood' authorizes ordinary return to Sgt Rill Desen, known independent Watch sergeant, at the Western District annex. Sources campaign/continuity/npcs.md and quests.md D205-QUENWOOD-VERDICT-001, prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md, world/politics/human-states.md. Original guilt verdict for endowment fraud and ordering seven poisoned gifts upheld on the independent admitted evidence; coerced confession remains excluded. Newly adjudicated independent court sentence life imprisonment and court-administered restitution, appeal result upheld and asset freeze without distribution, actual RNG receipt d4d356875bb136529ee828ac12d5999d. Desen reports public status, not DM-only financial truth or witness address. No automatic seized funds in V purse, no compensation amounts assumed, no named accomplice verdict or forced follow-up. No new V speech, resource consumption, or purchases.

V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 +1 Shield equipped old shield retained HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 boots; Fenar59/59 AC16 breastplate and Insignia HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, natural attacks+9, greataxe unchanged. Desen confirms from public court disposition: Quenwood sentenced to life imprisonment with court-ordered restitution from identified assets; appeal has been heard, conviction and sentence upheld (genuine d20 13; predeclared 1–3 limited procedural remand, 4–20 upheld). Assets frozen, no distribution yet (genuine d20 4; predeclared 1–5 freeze/no distribution, 6–15 partial, 16–20 verified liquid assets distributed). Desen can explain the available public disposition and permits a separate inquiry into authorized financial evidence if V chooses; no documents or new quest accepted or handed over. Cirren is relieved by the upheld conviction and concerned about beneficiaries awaiting compensation. V has made no new payment, speech, feature use or further commitment. Await V response.
